com.altastata.api

Class CloudFileOperationStatus

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.api.CloudFileOperationStatus

  • public class CloudFileOperationStatus
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents the status and progress of an asynchronous cloud file operation. Tracks the type of operation, its current AltaStataFileSystem.OperationState, progress value (0 to 1), details, streaming status, and any encountered errors. It provides event listener registries for state changes, progress updates, and streaming-started events to facilitate integration with graphical user interfaces and progress bars.
